source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
For each accident, identify the appropriate lines of the report. Put the **R/I** (Record/Incident) number in the first column only for incident records. Put the **R** (Record) number for the rest of the line entries (for example, lost days, medical expense, or damage).
3. In the details section of the RIR, put the PFR (Prefix) and RIN (Record Incident Number). No RIR shall contain a set of codes belonging to more than one record.
4. Determine the date the injured employee last worked a full day’s shift and the date the employee returned to full work. This date can include working part-time, working with restrictions or accommodations (must be the same number of hours), or being unable to return because of death.
5. Follow the instructions for coding in the appropriate handbook, such as the coding guide (the “code book”).
